reason: The goal says to arrange the mirrors around the triangular former, so I'll start there.

alternatives.reason: The shapes and cell also look useful, but the mirror arrangement is the current goal.

effect: The mirrors are arranged, and the next goal is to secure them with tape.
reaction: The explanation of repeating reflections makes me curious about the eventual pattern.
reason: The tape directly matches the next construction step.
expectation: I expect the tape to hold the mirror triangle together.

effect: The mirror triangle is secured, and the next goal is to put it in the viewing tube.
reaction: The result was straightforward; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The protective tube matches the current goal.

alternatives.reason: The colour cell will likely be needed later, but the tube is the next stated step.

reaction: The eyepiece makes the viewer feel closer to finished.
reason: This is the only offered combination and matches the current goal.
expectation: I expect the coloured pieces to be enclosed in the clear cell, ready to make patterns in the viewer.

expectation: I expect the colour drum to attach to the mirror tube so its shapes can be seen through the eyepiece.

effect: The rotating colour drum is attached; the next step is to cover it.
reaction: The assembly is progressing as expected.
reason: The only offered combination matches the current goal.
expectation: I expect the milky cover to fit over the drum and soften the light entering it.

effect: The light cover is fitted, and the kaleidoscope is ready to try with the lantern.
reaction: I'm curious to see the changing pattern.
reason: The only offered combination matches the goal of using the lantern and turning the kaleidoscope.
expectation: I expect to see a repeating coloured pattern that changes as the drum turns.

effect: The lantern test completed the kaleidoscope and showed how turning the drum rearranges the repeated shapes.
reaction: The transformation from a few shapes into a tumbling pattern was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Trying the finished kaleidoscope was most worthwhile because the repeated, changing pattern made the construction pay off.

leastWorthwhile.text: Taping the mirrors and sliding them into the tube were clear but fairly routine, with little unexpected happening.

surprise.text: The explanation that mirrors reflect one another as well as the view helped me understand how a small set of shapes becomes a larger pattern.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: each goal named a concrete construction step, though most choices simply followed that instruction.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see another mechanism explained and tested, although I would hope for more meaningful choices along the way.
